entries.reason: The editing target includes and calls SpriteStack runtime types; its manifest must pull in that runtime in the 3d authoring profile.

provides.absent_behavior: Unknown target capability identifiers return nullptr; the editing host owns the target lifetime.

requires.fallback: No editing target without the editing host.
The manifest enables the runtime through dependency closure; explicitly disabling it rejects the dependent editor configuration.
SpriteStackRuntime.cpp is excluded when model3d is absent; the document editing target remains available.

entries.thread_affinity: Editor owning thread; document state is owned by SpriteStackDocumentTarget and runtime resources follow the existing resource ownership contract.

trim.absent_profile: runtime-3d excludes authoring directories. No new L2/L3/L4 trim claim; this repair restores manifest dependency closure.
